candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Three untried coupled operators: (1) Depth-Adaptive Listric Hanging-Wall Vector Back-Projection (DALBP) warping subsurface gravity HGM, Thurston-Smith local wavenumber k_SPI, and MT conductivity gradient up-dip along -grad(Z_b)/||grad(Z_b)|| by listric horizontal offset Z_b * cot(delta_eff(Z_b)); (2) Harris-Forstner Multi-Physics Structure-Tensor Minor Eigenvalue sqrt(lambda_2(J_sigma)) explicitly capturing conjugate NNE x NW fault intersections and Y-splays suppressed by standard Frangi ridge filters; and (3) 2-Stage Spatially Cross-Fitted Context-Pyramid Stacker paired with Direct Self-Credit Regression q_self(x) = E[max_g k(d(x,g))] and Net Expected-DTI Minoux CELF placement.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: USGS QFaults and INGENIOUS mapped long single-azimuth subaerial range-front scarps, systematically missing (a) buried intrabasinal faults beneath 100-2,000 m of Plio-Quaternary fill whose potential-field steps are displaced 100-1,200 m basinward by listric fault dip, and (b) brecciated conjugate fault intersections and accommodation-zone horsetails (~39% of blind Great Basin geothermal systems per Faulds & Hinz 2015) where crossing strikes break 1D ridge trackers.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Intersecting bajada alluvial-fan distributary channels, buried Tertiary caldera ring-fracture/dike intersections, Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline cusps/spits, and highway/railroad interchanges.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.diff_from_repo: Differs from WBG-C1 (continuous Hessian commutator, 0 dots), WBG-H1 (fixed 500/600/1000 m scalar dip shifts), WBG-2 (0-feature random KDE), WBG-3 SPI-PMR (100 m only), WBG-3 EXP3DET (single-stage pixelwise HGB + greedy NMS), and WBG-S2 (single-stage pixelwise GBDT whose Frangi filter penalizes conjugate junctions, without self-credit FP penalization or untouched confirmation).

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Scale-normalized thin-plate elastic biharmonic rollover hinge nabla^4(Z_b) coupled with coaxial shallow electrical conductivity steepening ||grad(cond_surf)||.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: Deep listric master faults often terminate upward in broad monoclinal hanging-wall rollovers lacking brittle subaerial scarps.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Differential sediment compaction hinges over buried erosional paleovalleys and closed evaporite playa pans.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.diff_from_repo: Previously deferred as AFBD-1 in WBG-3; never coded or tested prior to WBG-4.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Directional quadrature Gabor envelope along-strike termination gradient detecting abrupt lateral offsets across transfer/accommodation zones.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: Strike-slip transfer faults in Great Basin accommodation zones have minimal vertical scarp throw yet laterally truncate magnetic and range-front blocks and host geothermal upflow.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Orthogonal erosional canyon breaches cutting volcanic hogbacks or cuesta ridges.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.diff_from_repo: Prior worm operators measured along-strike continuity rather than lateral strike-termination discontinuities.
